title: Re-derivable verdict manifest
description: Content-addressed receipt for a verdict v = I(E) with trust set T. Digest field names and algorithm are fixed by Core->Delivery Response 002 (2026-08-20): e_digest, i_digest, t_digest, v_digest, anchor_ref; SHA-256, lowercase hex, over canonical bytes (canonical.py). E, I, and T are carried as opaque digests so their preimages can evolve (e.g. verdict-instruments to stage-attribution instruments) without re-hashing frozen receipts.

created_at.description: RFC3339 UTC 'Z', canonical form (full seconds; fractional seconds shortest-exact, omitted when zero).

unicode_version.description: Unicode Character Database version of the sealing runtime (E14). The ACJ v2 hash preimage itself is UCD-independent (no normalisation); this field makes UCD-sensitive instrument operations (e.g. casefold) diagnosable when a verifier on a different runtime cannot re-derive.

ref.description: Path or locator of the archived evidence, hashed verbatim.

id.description: Human-readable instrument identity, e.g. refusal_sentinel@v3. The binding identity is i_digest.

set.description: Declared trust set T. Empty array = archive-closed (T=∅); ["M"] = dependency-closed; larger sets = T-closed.

verdict.description: The verdict content v, inline, in canonical structure (decimal quantities as canonical strings; no floats).

fidelity.description: OPTIONAL. On-face fidelity tier of the provenance the instrument consumed: 'exact' (provenance carried through the primitives; archive-closed, no error term) vs 'attested' (alignment-inferred at boundaries; stated error bound). Distinct axis from trust.set, which grades the trust base (archive-/dependency-/T-closed), not the input provenance's fidelity.

anchor_ref.description: Reference to the periodic Merkle anchor covering this manifest; null until anchored. Anchoring is periodic, not per-receipt.

manifest_id.description: SHA-256 of the canonical manifest content with this field absent. The manifest's own content address.
